data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Jawhar', meaning 'beautiful, lovely, elegant'. In Islamic tradition, the name Jaweeria is believed to represent the gentle, soft and beautiful nature of a woman. The name Jaweeria carries the meaning “Gentle, Soft, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Jaweeria usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaweeria total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
